Chapter 667: Chapter 8 Secret Realm Closure (5000 Words, Please Subscribe)_3

Chapter 667: Chapter 8 Secret Realm Closure (5000 words, please subscribe)_3

Causal Curse Killing is ethereal and intangible, but it is not omnipotent; there are still ways to counter it, such as the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, which can isolate causality.

Therefore—

In Lin Yuan’s plan,

if Tuoba Ancient God were to withstand the cursed killing,

Lin Yuan would immediately ask the Xia Qin Supreme Being to perform the cursed killing.

As a Supreme Being, cursing a Sixth Rank Life, unless Tuoba Ancient God also possessed a realm left by a Supreme Being like the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, there was no way to block it.

...

But now it seems,

Tuoba Ancient God appears unprepared in this regard.

Or rather, he did not anticipate that Lin Yuan did not take his threat seriously at all; he didn’t even bother to negotiate and directly had his friend completely cursed to death.

“Resurrect later?” The bearded old man sighed with relief amid his sorrow.

After learning from Lin Yuan that Fang Qing had fainted and it was related to the Ancient God, he had already prepared for the worst.

What kind of existence is an Ancient God?

And now it seems that Fang Qing is indeed dead.

However, the Galaxy Master does plan to ask a Supreme Being for resurrection later.

It’s known that although Sixth Rank Lives engrave their brand into the cosmos, forming a ‘Guiding Mark,’ which makes resurrection possible,

there are countless Sixth Rank Evolvers in Human Civilization.

If every time a Sixth Rank Evolver dies, a Supreme Being is needed for resurrection, then Supreme Beings would not get any rest but would be solely resuscitating Sixth Rank Evolvers.

Only those Sixth Rank Evolvers who have sufficient talent and qualifications can be resurrected by a Supreme Being.

And Fang Qing clearly does not meet this criterion; following the Ancient God’s Evolution Path is inherently risky, easily turning into a vessel for the Ancient God.

Supreme Beings generally do not resurrect such Evolvers.

But since Lin Yuan had said so, the bearded old man immediately believed him.

…

In the depths of the Cosmic Starry Sky,

within a Secret Realm,

Tuoba Ancient God sat cross-legged, his body so vast that it rivaled a star. As a rare special life form, when Tuoba Ancient God fully unfolded his body, it would be as enormous as a Constellation System.

“The Galaxy Master said he would consider it,”

“Wonder how he’s considering it?”

Tuoba Ancient God thought to himself.

In fact, his real goal was not the treasure that could boost the chances of achieving the Ultimate.

Even if Human Civilization really had it, they wouldn’t let the Galaxy Master mess around.

That was just a condition Tuoba Ancient God casually put forward, waiting for the Galaxy Master to negotiate.

Tuoba Ancient God’s ultimate goal was to have Human Civilization promote his Evolution Path.

Increasing the chance of striking the Ultimate was not just about treasures, but also various means.

For example, allowing his own Evolution Path to be more widely spread and having more cultivators practice it,

could achieve a similar effect.

But Human Civilization had always been suppressing the dissemination of the Ancient God Evolution Path.

This troubled Tuoba Ancient God, yet he had no solution.

But now, the current Galaxy Master gave him hope.

“Galaxy Master, if it’s you who steps forward, surely you could cause Human Civilization to regress and spread my Evolution Path. It should be no difficult task,”

Tuoba Ancient God thought while waiting for the Galaxy Master to contact him again.

At that moment,

a hum.

An invisible wave swept through.

“Hmm?”

Tuoba Ancient God slightly startled.

“Causality?”

Tuoba Ancient God’s expression changed.

“Not good.”

Tuoba Ancient God immediately sensed that the Spirit Will belonging to Fang Qing within him began to rapidly dissipate.

“Cursed killing?”

“Has someone cursed killed this Spirit Will?”

Tuoba Ancient God found it unbelievable, “The secret realm I’m in has the effect of weakening causality.”

“To perform a cursed killing, it must rely on the most closely linked object, such as using the physical body as a ‘medium’.”

“Did the Galaxy Master curse kill this Spirit Will?”

Tuoba Ancient God quickly realized, then became aware that he had misjudged the importance the Galaxy Master placed on Fang Qing.

If the Galaxy Master truly valued Fang Qing, he would at least have entangled with him. Directly executing a cursed killing? That held significant risk.

“The Galaxy Master doesn’t want to be threatened by me at all?”

Tuoba Ancient God fell silent for a while, enlightened about the Galaxy Master’s thoughts.

Tuoba Ancient God had a feeling that even if it was not Fang Qing he held, but the Galaxy Master’s parents or loved ones, the outcome would probably be the same.

…

After completely resolving Fang Qing’s issue,

Lin Yuan quickly returned to the Milky Way Main Star.

As the Galaxy Master, leaving the main star for a short time wasn’t a problem,

but being away from the main star for an extended period was somewhat precarious.

“The Supreme Being’s next resurrection operation will probably be in two thousand years,”

Lin Yuan thought privately, the resurrection methods of Supreme Beings generally involve accumulating a fixed number of subjects before carrying out a mass resurrection.

This method is the most convenient and also the most efficient.

“In two thousand years, the Main World’s two thousand years, I should have already stepped into Tier 11 by then and could also request the Supreme Being to resurrect Fang Qing,”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

If things went a bit smoother, two thousand years in the Main World, perhaps Lin Yuan himself would already be striking the Ultimate; maybe he would have reached it already.

Two thousand years in the Main World does not mean Lin Yuan only experienced two thousand years; through the traversal capability of the Door to the Myriad Realms, he might have actually lived through more than twenty thousand years.

With the numerous foundations and Against-Heaven’s Understanding that Lin Yuan possesses, another twenty thousand years to strike the Ultimate and enter the Ultimate is entirely possible.

…

Time slowly passed.

Twenty more years went by in a blink of an eye,

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan suddenly opened his eyes,

“A hundred years… are about to pass.”

“Xuanhuang Secret Realm will soon close.” Lin Yuan’s gaze turned toward the periphery of the realm,

as a large number of Ninth Rank Alien Race members, as well as Ninth Rank Evolvers from Human Civilization, appeared in the periphery. As for the inner area, many Ninth Rank Alien Race members were also gathering,

They were the hostile different species driven to this area by Human Civilization’s Evolvers.

“The realm is closing… My time to harvest has come…”

Lin Yuan’s face showed a smile, looking towards the despairing expressions of the Ninth Rank Alien Race members in the inner area, a grin spreading across his face.
